notes: The FY2025 20-F (year ended March 31, 2025) gives employees for India (250,553), the Americas (34,388), Europe (20,701) and the rest of the world (17,936). No single-country figure outside India, and no U.S. state breakdown, is given. The annual report PDF on infosys.com returned HTTP 403 to automated requests, so the SEC copy of the 20-F was used. Sites come from the 20-F table of most significant properties (buildings over 500,000 sq ft or land over 440,000 sq ft), in this column order: location, building sq ft, seating capacity, ownership, land sq ft, ownership. The 20-F says Infosys has a presence in 292 locations across 59 countries. The 20-F lists Hyderabad under Andhra Pradesh; it is now in Telangana, so place omits the state.
